title: Sovereignty conformance disclosure pack
description: The redacted, publishable subset of an F-SV-05 verdict an operator links from their USED-BY.md row (F-ADOPT-02). The schema is the redaction contract in machine-readable form: additionalProperties is false at every level, so a pack carrying raw observed values, observation payloads, or any field outside the allowlist does not validate. Per indicator the pack carries the outcome and the band pair — the posture, not the telemetry. No score of any kind.

profile.description: Stable id of the profile the record was judged against.

record.description: The evidence record's artifact_id (already digest-shaped; carries no endpoint or internal literal).

record_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact record bytes evaluated, so a reviewer holding the record can verify which snapshot the pack discloses.

indicators.description: Every indicator the verdict carries — including fail, unobserved and unprofiled outcomes. A pack that renders only its passing rows is not a disclosure.

pass.description: Boolean roll-up: true iff every indicator outcome is pass. Never a count, ratio or score.
